About.title: 👨‍💻 About me
About.sobre: Full Stack Software Engineer with experience building complex web applications across marketplace platforms, payment gateway flows, and financial solutions. I currently work at Wite Group, contributing directly to the development and evolution of a fintech platform. I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development and bring a strong focus on code quality, scalability, performance, and user experience. I'm driven by continuous learning, collaboration, and delivering solutions with real impact.

Project1.title: FoodBoxd
Project1.description: FoodBoxd is a menu and review management system for cafeterias, developed in React Native with Firebase integration. It allows managers to create and edit daily/weekly menus, monitor user feedback, and view performance charts. Users can check menus, rate meals, and view nutritional info.

Project2.title: 🌸 Takusan - Discover Animes
Project2.description: 🎌 Takusan is a web app that lets you explore popular anime, view full details such as trailers, characters, and genres, and navigate a modern, animated UI. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and Framer Motion, this project focuses on user experience and performance.

Project3.title: Multi-Tenant Workshop Management System
Project3.description: A full-stack multi-tenant platform designed for automotive workshops, featuring customer and vehicle management, service orders, scheduling, inventory control, point of sale, and financial management with a scalable architecture.

Project4.title: Sentinel
Project4.description: A scalable Go API for secure payment webhook processing, idempotency, and real-time fraud risk scoring using rule-based analysis.
